scientific_integrity: All computations are reproducible from the standalone verification script; analytical statements rest on written spectral-resolvent and monotonicity arguments. Similar known Fano and dark-state effects are credited. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two finite positive arm lengths; unit real hopping; single lossless lead; one unit-coupled root; small positive uniform onsite detuning of the second arm. The linewidth error is not uniform when arm lengths grow. No absorption, nonlinear transport or many-body dynamics. The general Fano/BIC mechanisms are established prior science; historical priority for the precise coefficient remains provisional.
title: Arithmetic bound states and quadratic Fano-notch widths in a two-arm quantum stub
